development_controls.reason: Four initial Anthropic representative controls used earlier managed settings without the final CLI preinstallation. Final input parity invalidated reuse; all four were rerun on final copies.

inherited_evidence: Original 126 Gemini runtime trials and sample reviews apply to byte-identical components only; they are not new OpenAI/Anthropic trials.
limitations: Oracle/nop and trusted probes do not establish model performance or pass-rate calibration.
Native CLI tool restrictions require the separate provider-specific CLI evidence.
One representative task per provider receives new reset/MCP/network controls; all seven receive oracle/nop.
Application probes cover finite destinations/protocols. Harbor permits native local/DNS/ICMP exceptions.
Private receipts include oracle answers and must not enter any agent image.
